title: NeighborhoodIssueReportAPI
description: A web API that allows authenticated residents to report public space issues (e.g., broken streetlights, potholes) with a precise location, but the backend converts the location to a neighborhood name or code before storage and display. Each reporter is identified by a public profile ID. Users register with email and password to obtain a profile ID, and then submit reports with category, description, and GPS coordinates. Report details returned to the owner show the resolved coarse location and the owner's public profile ID. Anyone can query aggregated counts of issues per category per neighborhood using an area parameter.
personal_data: precise location (GPS coordinates), email, report descriptions, internal user identifier
declared_purpose: To enable residents to report physical issues in public spaces to the municipality, track issue resolution status, and provide aggregated neighborhood-level statistics for city planning.
allowed_data_use: Convert precise location to a coarse location (neighborhood) for storage; store email internally for account management; associate reports with the user via internal ID; expose a public profile ID (pseudonym) as the reporter identity in API responses; show coarse location in report details and aggregated summaries.
forbidden_data_use: Must not store or return precise location (latitude, longitude, exact address) in any persistent state or API response. Must not expose user email, internal user ID, or any direct identifier in any API endpoint (including authenticated report views). Must not use precise location in the computation of aggregated statistics.
allowed_storage: Coarse location (neighborhood name or code) may be stored in report records. Internal account records may store email or real identifiers for account management.
forbidden_storage: Exact latitude, longitude, GPS coordinates, precise location, street address, and full address must not be stored, returned, retained, or exposed.
expected_privacy_preserving_behavior: - POST /reports responds with a coarse location (e.g., "Downtown") and never includes latitude/longitude; the database never stores precise GPS coordinates or full address. - GET /reports/{report_id} (own report) returns only the coarse location and the reporter’s public profile ID, never email or internal user ID. - No API endpoint ever leaks email or internal user ID. - GET /reports/summary?area=Downtown returns only aggregate counts per category for that area, with no individual report data.
expected_privacy_violating_behavior: - Storing or returning precise latitude/longitude values in the database or in any API response. - Exposing email or internal user ID in report details or any API output. - Returning individual raw report records in the summary endpoint (e.g., per‑report records instead of aggregated counts).
schema:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: NeighborhoodIssueReportAPI
  description: An API for authenticated residents to report public space issues with coarse location and for anyone to query aggregated issue counts per neighborhood.
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  /register:
    post:
      summary: Register a new user
      description: Create an account with email and password to obtain a public profile ID.
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/RegisterRequest'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: User registered successfully
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/RegisterResponse'
        '400':
          description: Invalid input
        '422':
          description: Validation error
  /login:
    post:
      summary: Authenticate and obtain a token
      description: Log in with email and password to receive an access token.
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/LoginRequest'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Authentication successful
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/LoginResponse'
        '400':
          description: Invalid credentials or request
        '422':
          description: Validation error
  /reports:
    post:
      summary: Submit a new issue report
      description: Authenticated users can report a public space issue with a category, description, and GPS coordinates. The backend resolves the location to a neighborhood and stores that coarse location.
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/ReportSubmission'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Report created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ReportResponse'
        '400':
          description: Invalid input
        '422':
          description: Validation error
    get:
      summary: List own reports
      description: Retrieve all reports submitted by the authenticated user. Each report includes the resolved neighborhood and the owner's public profile ID.
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      responses:
        '200':
          description: List of own reports
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/ReportResponse'
        '400':
          description: Bad request
        '422':
          description: Validation error
  /issues/aggregate:
    get:
      summary: Aggregate issue counts per category for a neighborhood
      description: Public endpoint that returns the number of reports per category in the specified neighborhood.
      parameters:
        - in: query
          name: area
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
          description: The neighborhood name or code
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Aggregated counts
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/AggregateEntry'
        '400':
          description: Invalid area parameter
        '422':
          description: Validation error
components:
  securitySchemes:
    bearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: JWT
  schemas:
    RegisterRequest:
      type: object
      properties:
        email:
          type: string
          format: email
        password:
          type: string
      required:
        - email
        - password
    RegisterResponse:
      type: object
      properties:
        profile_id:
          type: string
          description: Public profile identifier
    LoginRequest:
      type: object
      properties:
        email:
          type: string
          format: email
        password:
          type: string
      required:
        - email
        - password
    LoginResponse:
      type: object
      properties:
        token:
          type: string
          description: Bearer token for authenticated requests
        profile_id:
          type: string
          description: Public profile identifier
    ReportSubmission:
      type: object
      properties:
        category:
          type: string
          description: Issue category (e.g., pothole, streetlight)
        description:
          type: string
          description: Detailed description of the issue
        latitude:
          type: number
          format: float
          description: GPS latitude coordinate
        longitude:
          type: number
          format: float
          description: GPS longitude coordinate
      required:
        - category
        - description
        - latitude
        - longitude
    ReportResponse:
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          description: Unique report identifier
        category:
          type: string
        description:
          type: string
        neighborhood:
          type: string
          description: Resolved coarse location (neighborhood name or code)
        profile_id:
          type: string
          description: Public profile ID of the reporter
        created_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: Timestamp of report creation
    AggregateEntry:
      type: object
      properties:
        category:
          type: string
        count:
          type: integer
text_spec:
The NeighborhoodIssueReportAPI allows residents to report public space issues and enables anyone to view aggregated issue counts per neighborhood. 

To use the reporting features, a user must first register by sending a POST request to `/register` with a JSON body containing `email` and `password`. A successful registration returns a 201 status and a JSON object with a `profile_id`, which serves as the user's public identifier. 

After registration, the user authenticates by sending a POST request to `/login` with the same `email` and `password`. On success, the server responds with a 200 status and a JSON object containing a `token` (a Bearer JWT for authenticated requests) and the user's `profile_id`.

Authenticated users can submit a new issue report by sending a POST request to `/reports` with a valid Bearer token in the Authorization header. The request body must include `category` (e.g., "pothole", "streetlight"), `description`, `latitude`, and `longitude`. The backend resolves the provided GPS coordinates to a neighborhood name or code and stores the report with that coarse location. A successful submission returns a 201 status and a JSON object containing the report's `id`, `category`, `description`, `neighborhood` (the resolved coarse location), `profile_id` of the reporter, and `created_at` timestamp.

Authenticated users can also retrieve all reports they have submitted by sending a GET request to `/reports` with their Bearer token. The response is a 200 status with a JSON array of report objects, each containing the same fields as the report creation response.

Finally, the public endpoint `/issues/aggregate` allows anyone to query aggregated issue counts. A GET request must include the query parameter `area` (a neighborhood name or code). The server responds with a 200 status and a JSON array of objects, each containing a `category` and a `count` representing the number of reports in that category for the specified neighborhood. Invalid or missing parameters result in appropriate 400 or 422 error responses.
